decision.reason: Fervo's 24 September grid synchronization and 30 September COD for first 33MW GeoBlock, with remaining two blocks in commissioning, creates a versioned evidence/acceptance handoff per unit. Trigger verified with Fervo first-party release and IEEE coverage. Competition deferred to Validation.
decision.article_title: Fervo’s Utah Geothermal Plant Starts Sending Clean Power To The Grid - IEEE Spectrum

opportunities.core_job: Record and verify project commissioning milestones, testing outcomes and PPA commercial-operations evidence across individual GeoBlocks
opportunities.target_customer: Enhanced geothermal project developer commissioning and commercial operations teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: GeoBlock register → milestone requirements → test/flow output CSV → PPA threshold check → signed evidence and exceptions
opportunities.why_now: Fervo's first 33MW Cape Station block achieved grid synchronization in September and contract COD on 30 September 2026; two further blocks are commissioning
opportunities.before_state: Geothermal development drilling, test, project finance, PPA milestone and owner acceptance evidence are fragmented across teams
opportunities.after_state: For each GeoBlock, signed trace of First Power → output test → PPA threshold → contractual COD with exceptions and source documents

source_observations.observation: First 33 MW unit reached contractual commercial operations 30 September; further two GeoBlocks remain in commissioning. Source company directly.
